title: How to mobilize the agile science needed in a crisis
title_zh: 如何动员危机中所需的敏捷科学
abstract: Two reports highlight the changes needed in academia to facilitate the fast, collaborative, responsive and inclusive research that aids global decision makers.
abstract_zh: 两份报告强调了学术界需要做出的改变，以促进快速、协作、响应式和包容性的研究，从而支持全球决策者。
